## Introduction

For this portfolio you'll be using the `economics` dataset to explore changes in variables across a time series.

## Requirements

Download the `portfolio09.qmd` template file.

1. Ensure you fill in your name in the author field.
2. Generate a variable for the change in annual median personal savings rate and another variable for change in annual median unemployment rate.
3. Create an appropriate chart(s) to illustrate these two new variables over time.
4. Consider carefully what the "story" of your chart is and use the title/subtitle or annotation to help highlight the story.
5. Provide a **brief** interpretation of your chart for a general audience. Expect 3-4 sentences (~100-150 words).
6. Ensure your chart has clear labels and all parts are legible. 
7. You should submit the `portfolio09.qmd` file to the stream dropbox.
8. Make sure that it renders correctly before submission.

 
**Our expectation is this should take you approximately one hour.** You may spend more or less time than this if you wish, but there is no need to do so if your portfolio satisfies the criteria above.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple"}

### Grading rubric

You will be graded out of 10 based on:

|  |  |  |
|---------|---------------------------------------------------------|------|
| **Reproducibility** | Your .qmd file renders correctly without errors or warnings | 2 |
|  | Your .qmd file renders but has warnings | 1 |
|  | Your .qmd file doesn't render without modification | 0 |
| **Explanation** | Your explanation is appropriate and well written | 2 |
|  | Minor errors in grammar or spelling which do not distract from the meaning | 1 |
|  | Your .qmd file doesn't render without modification | 0 |
| **Chart** | Your chart satisfies all criteria and is well labelled | 2 |
|  | Your chart has major flaws, is missing criteria or is confusing  | 1 |
|  | Missing or entirely incorrect | 0 |
| **Formatting** | Your document renders to the correct format and chart(s) are clearly visible. | 2 |
|  | Your document does not render correctly, and/or parts are cut off | 1 |
|  | Your document does not render at all due to code errors, major parts of your figures or text are cut off | 0 |
:::
